name: Should I choose a general contractor or a design-build firm for my office renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a general contractor or a design-build firm for my office renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between a general contractor and a design-build firm depends on your project's needs. A general contractor executes plans provided by a separate architect or designer. A design-build firm, like Opus Builders, offers integrated services, managing both design and construction under one contract. This approach often leads to better communication, streamlined processes, fewer disputes, and a single point of accountability, potentially saving time and cost while ensuring design intent is fully realized.
acceptedAnswer.description: A design-build firm integrates design and construction under one contract, offering streamlined communication and single accountability, unlike a general contractor.
